sloka: अथ प्रतिसंआदिष्टो लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा ।प्रविवेश गुहाम् रम्याम् किष्किंधाम् राम शासनात् ॥४-३३-१॥
transliteration: atha pratisaṁādiṣṭo lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā ।praviveśa guhām ramyām kiṣkiṁdhām rāma śāsanāt ॥4-33-1॥

translations.english: Instructed by Rama, and having been permitted, Lakshmana, the slayer of enemies entered the frightful cave of Kishkinda.
